VAR SubsystemVal = 'Project WD+WR+INCO+Acciona'[Subsystem Code]

VAR DigitSys = MID(SystemVal, 2, 1)

    NOT(SubIsInvalid) && DigitSub IN {"1", "2", "3", "4"},

        "HA" & DigitSys,

            'HA l0_abs_guide'[Handover Area],

    )
